description: This file contains utility functions for reading files if they exist and for collecting plugin source metadata from a specific directory structure within a repository. It primarily deals with filesystem operations, reading JSON configurations, and organizing plugin info.

methods.name: readIfExists
methods.description: Reads the contents of a given file path if it exists, returning null if the file does not exist or an error occurs.

methods.name: collectBundledPluginSources
methods.description: Collects metadata about bundled plugin sources from the 'extensions' directory within a repository, optionally requiring each plugin to have a 'package.json'.
